token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password='Qk--@(w')['access_token']

# 1) Get all your playlists in playlist library (both pages)
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlists page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        # keep looping once more to confirm end (safe)
        pass

playlist_ids=[p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists]
print('total playlists', len(playlist_ids))

# 2) Collect all artists from classical-genre songs in any of those playlists
classical_artist_by_id={}  # id -> name
classical_song_ids=[]

for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=token)
    for song in pl.get('songs', []):
        sid = song.get('id')
        # Determine classical genre based on show_song.genre
        s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        genre = (s.get('genre') or '').lower()
        if genre == 'classical':
            classical_song_ids.append(sid)
            for a in s.get('artists', []):
                classical_artist_by_id[a['id']] = a.get('name')

print('classical songs count', len(classical_song_ids))
print('classical song ids', sorted(set(classical_song_ids)))
print('target classical artist ids', sorted(classical_artist_by_id.keys()))
print('target classical artist names', [classical_artist_by_id[i] for i in sorted(classical_artist_by_id.keys())])

# 3) Get current following artists (pagination)
following_artist_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('following page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following_artist_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    page_index += 1

print('currently following artist ids', sorted(following_artist_ids))

# 4) Follow missing artists
missing_artist_ids=[aid for aid in classical_artist_by_id.keys() if aid not in following_artist_ids]
print('missing to follow', sorted(missing_artist_ids))

results=[]
for aid in sorted(missing_artist_ids):
    try:
        resp = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
        print('follow_artist', aid, 'resp', resp)
        results.append((aid,'ok'))
    except Exception as e:
        print('follow_artist', aid, 'error', str(e))
        results.append((aid,'fail',str(e)))

print('follow results', results)

# 5) Verify following status for all target artists
verify={}
for aid in sorted(classical_artist_by_id.keys()):
    try:
        st = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
        print('is following', aid, st)
        verify[aid]=st.get('following')
    except Exception as e:
        print('verify error', aid, str(e))

print('verification', verify)
